paragraphs.source_en: At first Toshikatsu had thought Nobuhide was confident of handling the matter alone, but he later discovered that this was not so. Hirate Masahide, who had reportedly never once left Nagoya Castle since Nobunaga’s marriage, had now hastened to Anshō Castle as one of Nobuhide’s advisers. The lord of Anshō Castle was Nobunaga’s elder half brother, Nobuhiro. With both Oda Nobuhide and Hirate Masahide gone from Owari, its defenses had consequently grown weak. Nobuhide’s true purpose in ordering Toshikatsu not to leave the castle, then, must have been to preserve a place of retreat should Anshō Castle fall.
